description: Fixtures derived from real OFAC list changes, for a future test harness (no harness exists yet). Two assertion kinds, kept separate: 'entity_match' asks whether the query resolves to the same party; 'list_membership' asks whether that party is on a specific list as of a date - a delisting asserts only 'not on list X as of date Y', never universal clearance, since other designations or lists may persist. Queries marked synthetic are constructed variants with no expected-result oracle.
